note: The review sheet's numbers (docs/rules/assets.md, The review sheet and Numbers). A reviewer who did not build the piece scores it on these criteria and writes review.json beside it (assets:blind-reviewer-scores-views); acceptance is assets:acceptance-score-thresholds; a landmark also passes assets:landmarks-match-reference-outlines.

criteria.name: Reads at phone size
criteria.5: In the phone shot, named in one look, and its key part shows

criteria.name: Silhouette
criteria.5: The four orthographic outlines alone say what it is

criteria.name: Proportion
criteria.5: Every measured size inside the part rules; doors, storeys and people agree

criteria.name: Palette use
criteria.5: Palette only, main mass reads against ground and neighbours, wear in the worn shades
criteria.3: Palette only, but flat or muddy against the street
criteria.1: Fails the palette check (the check stops it before review)

criteria.name: Wear and clutter
criteria.5: The right clutter for its kind, where it would be (assets:buildings-carry-wear-and-clutter)

criteria.name: Variety against the examples
criteria.5: Plainly the same family as the accepted examples, and plainly its own
criteria.3: Near a copy of one, or a small break in style

criteria.name: Budget
criteria.5: At or under 80% of every figure
criteria.4: At or under 100% of every figure

acceptance: Accepted when no criterion scores under minEach, phone scores at least minPhone, the mean is at least minMean, and budget is not 0 (assets:acceptance-score-thresholds). A landmark must also have every outline view at or above outlineMin with its width and height within dimTolerancePct (assets:landmarks-match-reference-outlines). A person checks landmarks and anything that shows a place's name last.

gets: the renders in the asset's renders folder and their manifest
the reference's description: the outline.json sources and notes
never: the code that builds the piece
reviewer.writes: review.json beside the asset, in the Review shape of packages/assets/src/types.ts; the budget score is read from the register row by the check, not judged
